Merged code builds Box and calls enqueue at chupa/runner.py:239,243,537-549, chupa/stages.py:488-490,569-587, chupa/flake.py:164 and chupa/box.py:190 (bootstrap ingest). None of these is in the activation row's fence floor. So the seed would have to make up a durable record value (each producer's occurrence_id), and possibly its fence additions. This ticket's own Scope tells the implementer to earn this from code reads, but code reads cannot supply a missing record recipe. Under 19.L SPEC DEPTH that makes it a spec_gap.

If the registry row's fence must change, make that a plan edit. Then re-author this seeding ticket so it cites the hardened unit.
